scripts.build:web: EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 EXPO_OFFLINE=1 expo export --platform web && node scripts/offline-web.cjs
scripts.build:ios: EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 EXPO_OFFLINE=1 expo export --platform ios --output-dir dist-ios
scripts.format: prettier --write App.tsx src tests scripts *.json *.md docs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check App.tsx src tests scripts *.json *.md docs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run format:check
